name: Survey tile in Pisces
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 1.3 degrees south of the ecliptic in Pisces, imaged by SPHEREx 9 times in 3 visits over 18 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 16 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 18 hours starting 2025-12-13, at wavelengths from 1.11 to 4.71 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
